The "Explore – Sizing" page is built in Lew42 v2 (page `33:3`), and I've sent the report to `mastermind-figma`. I reviewed it in two screenshots, one before and one after widening the table and adding the gotchas block.

[Open the page frame in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/ADpu9u2V0BlEZfR3rrMfER?node-id=34-28)

- **Table:** a 3×3 grid, with rows for width Fixed/Hug/Fill and columns for height Fixed/Hug/Fill.
- **Diagrams:** each cell has a real auto-layout parent with a real child set to that combination. Arrows point in for Hug, out for Fill, and bars mark Fixed.
- **Examples and CSS:** each cell has an example label (paragraph, button, full-height sidebar, main area, and so on) and its CSS equivalent. The `flex: 1` vs `width: 100%` difference is in the Fill × Fill and Fill × Fixed cells and in the gotchas.
- **Short and long text:** the Fill × Hug (paragraph) cell shows both, and the box grows when the text wraps.
- **Gotchas:** a dark-scheme block at the bottom.
- **Variables:** padding, gap and radius are bound to the Scale variables, and text and surface colours to the Scheme variables. Diagram stage sizes, arrow glyphs and font sizes are hardcoded.
- **Not done:** the CSS blocks use Inter, not a monospace font. The table is narrower than the page frame (cells are 620px in a 2300px frame).

The Live board is built and reported. Summary of what landed:

- **New "Live" page** in the Claude November 2026 file (`woCZQDoXKJW3GcJPZukW7f`, page `45:49`): a 2600-wide board (`48:49`) with topic list (left, current highlighted), headed topic cards with bullets (centre, all 9 of today's topics), and a Note/Decision/Question sidebar (right) — Decision and Question marked by icon + fill/outline, never colour alone.
- **Reused what existed correctly**: renamed the old same-named page (an unrelated card-override test) instead of overwriting it; confirmed the Design System file's own "Live" status board is a different thing in a different file, so I didn't duplicate it.
- **Found and fixed a real Figma Plugin API trap**: `resize()` silently resets HUG sizing back to FIXED, which had clipped several frames to near-zero height — documented in `doc/live-board.md` so it isn't hit again.
- **Doc + update recipe** committed at `public/framework/ext/Figma/doc/live-board.md`, linked from the Figma readme, so later asks are short `use_figma` calls instead of a rebuild.
- Reported to `mastermind-figma` (my parent) with the board link, component ids, and the recipe. Staying alive for follow-up live updates as the brief asked.

Task landed. Summary:

- **Landing line appended** to `session.jsonl` with title, outcome and links (board, page, doc, readme).
- **Readme law satisfied**: `ext/Figma/readme.md` got the Docs line for `doc/live-board.md`, which itself documents the component ids, properties, and what writes/reads them.
- **No card existed** for this sub-task (checked `list_cards` and both relevant session logs), so `card_reply` was skipped rather than inventing one — the full report already went to `mastermind-figma` directly.
- Staying alive, as the brief asked, for any live follow-up edits to the board.

Both are just inbox-visibility echoes — the clarity rewrite I already acknowledged, and my own earlier reports still queued in `mastermind-figma`'s inbox awaiting its next turn. Nothing new to act on. The Live board task is landed, documented, and reported; I'm staying alive and idle for any live follow-up edits, as the brief asked.

Section B is done. I added seven `Page` instances to `1920 Pages`, one per Scale mode. They sit in a labelled row beside the master, in a row node `Pages · one per Scale mode` (50:4077). I didn't touch the master.

Each instance is named `Page · <resolution> <name>`, has its Scale mode set explicitly, and has its width bound to the `width` variable. Height is Hug. Reading the nodes back through the API, every width binding and mode resolved correctly. I took one screenshot of the row, but at 10,960 px wide it was too small to read, so the numbers below come from the readback.

| Instance | Width × height | Padding |
|---|---|---|
| `Page · 360 XS` | 360×76 | 16 |
| `Page · 400 Mobile` | 400×108 | 24 horizontal, 32 vertical |
| `Page · 600 SM` | 600×108 | 32 |
| `Page · 1000 Default` | 1000×140 | 48 |
| `Page · 1600 LG` | 1600×172 | 64 |
| `Page · 2600 XL` | 2600×204 | 80 |
| `Page · 3440 Mega` | 3440×300 | 128 |

The master binds left and right padding to `pad-x` and top and bottom to `section-pad-y`, so padding follows each mode as intended. Nothing in the master blocked the width binding or the Hug height.

The master's placeholder text ("asdf") is overridden on each instance to show its mode label.

Link: https://www.figma.com/design/ADpu9u2V0BlEZfR3rrMfER?node-id=50-4077. I sent the same report to `mastermind-figma` and closed the task.

The `Explore – Drag playground` page is built and reported to `mastermind-figma`: [open the root frame](https://www.figma.com/design/ADpu9u2V0BlEZfR3rrMfER?node-id=50-4107) (page id 50:4106). One full-page screenshot looked right, and the drag test passed. I did not screenshot a layout with cards dropped in.

- **Layouts:** four, each with a different Scale mode in every region, labelled `<resolution> <name>`.
  - Sidebar + main: 360 XS sidebar, 1000 Default main.
  - 2 columns: 600 SM, 3440 Mega.
  - 3 columns: 400 Mobile, 1000 Default, 2600 XL.
  - 4 columns: 360 XS, 600 SM, 1600 LG, 3440 Mega.
  - Columns are Fill height and their padding and gap come from the Scale variables.
- **Tray:** 8 loose `Card` instances with Scale left on Auto, Fill width, and text from one character to long wrapping paragraphs. A one-line "what to try" sits at the top.
- **Drag test:** I moved a card into three of the columns with `appendChild` and read its resolved mode and padding. Each time it picked up that column's mode, then it went back to 1000 Default in the tray. It stayed Fill width, and I restored it to the tray afterwards.
  - 360 XS column: padding 16, gap 12, radius 3.
  - 2600 XL column: padding 80, gap 48, radius 8.
  - 3440 Mega column: padding 128, gap 64, radius 6.
  - Tray: padding 48, gap 32, radius 4.
- **Narrow Mega column:** a card dropped into the 3440 Mega column of the 4-column layout gets crushed. The 128 padding is too big for that column. This is the effect showing, not a bug.

No new masters, variables or styles were made. I logged the work in my task log and sent the report to `mastermind-figma`. Cost is roughly $2 of the $6 budget.

Section C is closed, and nothing was left running. The task now reads complete, with the page link and test numbers as evidence. The Figma page is [Explore – Drag playground](https://www.figma.com/design/ADpu9u2V0BlEZfR3rrMfER?node-id=50-4107). The report went to `mastermind-figma` earlier.
The organised frame looks mostly tidy; the overlaps are likely in the masters area at left. Inspecting `Layout.Miller.Mobile Set` and the sidebar sets next.

I ran the checklist's "After building" steps on the Drag playground page. The whole-page screenshot looks right, but I only took that one shot and no per-section shots.

- **Changed:** every label is now 16 px, down from 24 px (tray, four layout titles, eleven region labels). The what-to-try line is 16 px and capped at 720 px wide, down from 1400 px.
- **Already compliant:** the page has no new masters, and the loose cards are 8 `Card` 16:364 instances with Scale left on Auto. The layouts are plain auto-layout frames with no fixed heights (Hug, with a 640 minimum). Sidebars and columns are Fill height, and the sidebar is a fixed 360 rail. Scale is set per region and differs in each.
- **Checked:** I saw no overlaps or cut-off text. A long card title wraps to 3 lines in the tray. The tray cards are 328 wide, so they are already narrower than 400.
- **Still off:**
  - The layouts are empty drop zones, because the cards sit only in the tray.
  - The tray is one tall column, about 3200 px, taller than the layouts.
  - I didn't add `Button` (Elements, 23:506), since the brief asked only for cards.

Brief D is done. Summary:

**Delivered:** `public/framework/ext/Figma/doc/page-audit.md` (commit `85d2d9262`) — a read-only screenshot audit of every Lew42 v2 page except `AI` and `Live`, with 18 new screenshots plus the existing 2600 XL ones reused, and a new Docs line in `ext/Figma/readme.md`.

**Headline finding:** the live `Button` component's label fails WCAG AA contrast (2.6 vs. the 4.5 floor) on every Scheme — confirmed by the Explore – Color permutations page's own computed numbers, not a judgment call. It's wrong on every page with a button, so it's a one-token fix rather than a per-page one. Prime-scheme text fails separately.

**The mastermind's overlap question:** checked the five parked `Layout.*` Set masters on 2600 XL by node geometry rather than eyeballing the downscaled screenshot — they have a clean, consistent 160px gap between each one, no overlap.

Reported to `mastermind-figma` and closed the task (nothing left open).
